title: Learning Hub and your first learning cycle
objectives: Complete a lesson, attempt a quiz and distinguish practice from approval.
explanation: Open the Learning Hub with your assigned account, select an assigned course and read the lesson objectives. Work through the explanation and exercise before taking the quiz. Review feedback, revisit the relevant lesson and retry when the platform permits. A recorded completion shows learning activity; it does not authorize electrical work or certify job competence.

The knowledge library separates approved records from clearly labeled samples. Check title, version, source, approval state and applicability before using a document. Course publication and knowledge approval are separate controls. If internal policy is unavailable, ask HR or your supervisor for the current approved document. AI practice cannot supply missing company authority.
example: A sample checklist appears in the library. You may use it for the exercise, but should not treat it as permission to perform a live installation.
exercise: Open one course, complete its first lesson, locate its source note and identify its approval label.
model_response: Record the course and lesson IDs, the visible Draft/sample label and the source reference; confirm completion persists after reopening.
key_points: Read and practise before the quiz
